description.value: La Galleria Fine Foods is an award-winning Italian deli and specialty food shop located in Edgemont Village on the North Shore. It offers a broad menu of freshly made sandwiches, soups, chowders, lasagna, salads, and antipasto alongside a curated selection of packaged Italian pantry staples. For a touring cyclist passing through North Vancouver, it is a strong stop for a hearty sandwich or soup and resupply of packaged provisions.
